lessonTitle: 9. Equations of a line and a circle
lessonTitleEnglish: Equations of a line and a circle
unit: Algebra · Chapter 1. Properties of numerical functions
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Every line in the plane has an equation ax + by + c = 0; if b ≠ 0 it can be written y = kx + m.
stages.headlineEnglish: Every line in the plane has an equation ax + by + c = 0; if b ≠ 0 it can be written y = kx + m.

stages.headline: The circle with centre (x₀; y₀) and radius r has equation (x − x₀)² + (y − y₀)² = r².
stages.headlineEnglish: The circle with centre (x₀; y₀) and radius r has equation (x − x₀)² + (y − y₀)² = r².

stages.headline: A point lies on the circle if its coordinates satisfy the equation, e.g. (3; 1): 4 + 0 = 4.
stages.headlineEnglish: A point lies on the circle if its coordinates satisfy the equation, e.g. (3; 1): 4 + 0 = 4.
